title: Automated Refill Program Eligibility of Prescriptions by Handling Class
content:
A prescription of Kestrel Prescriptions may join Auto Refill, Med Sync or adherence packaging only where its handling class switches that kind of program on. The Patient Care Desk reads the class of the prescription against this table.

| Handling class | Auto Refill | Med Sync | Adherence packaging |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Controlled Acute Prescription | No | No | No |
| Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Schedule V Controlled Prescription | No | Yes | No |
| Schedule III-IV Controlled Prescription | No | No | No |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription | No | No | No |
| Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription | Yes | No | No |

- **Auto Refill** — whether a prescription of the class may be enrolled in an Auto Refill program.
- **Med Sync** — whether it may be enrolled in a Med Sync program.
- **Adherence packaging** — whether it may be dispensed in adherence packaging.

**Desk readings.** A Schedule V Controlled Prescription may join Med Sync but not Auto Refill. A Specialty Limited-Distribution Prescription may join Auto Refill but not Med Sync. Only the Non-Controlled Maintenance Prescription class may be dispensed in adherence packaging.
